vulkanmod.options.advCulling.tooltip: Use a culling algorithm that might improve performance by reducing the number of non visible chunk sections rendered.
vulkanmod.options.ao.subBlock.tooltip: Enables smooth lighting for non full block (experimental).
vulkanmod.options.entityCulling.tooltip: Skips entities hidden behind terrain (uses the chunk occlusion graph). Glowing and leashed entities are always drawn.
vulkanmod.options.tpsCompensation.toolti: Singleplayer/LAN: when the world lags, block breaking, eating, drinking and bow charging follow real time instead of slowed-down server ticks. No effect on multiplayer servers.
vulkanmod.options.particleLimit.tooltip: Caps the number of particles alive at once. Helps against mass TNT/explosion lag. With a limit, big explosions show less smoke. OFF = vanilla.
vulkanmod.options.itemRenderDistance.too: Dropped items farther than this are not drawn. Helps after griefing, when hundreds of items lie on the ground. OFF = vanilla (Entity Distance).
vulkanmod.options.mobRenderDistance.tool: Mobs and animals farther than this are not drawn. Players, bosses, glowing and named entities are always drawn. OFF = vanilla (Entity Distance).
vulkanmod.options.frameQueue.tooltip: Higher values might help stabilize frametime but will increase input lag.
vulkanmod.options.backfaceCulling.toolti: Culls not visible block faces on the CPU improving GPU performance. To prevent increased CPU overhead enable Indirect Draw.
vulkanmod.options.indirectDraw.tooltip: Reduces CPU overhead but might increase GPU overhead.
vulkanmod.options.gpuOcclusionCulling.to: Nvidium-style culling on the GPU: chunk sections hidden behind terrain are not drawn. Needs Indirect Draw.
vulkanmod.options.uniqueOpaqueLayer.tool: Use a unique render layer for opaque terrain to improve performance.
vulkanmod.options.wayland.tooltip: Use Linux Wayland compositor if available (Experimental). Requires restart.
vulkanmod.options.extra.animOther.toolti: Sea lanterns, prismarine, magma, command blocks and every other animated texture.
vulkanmod.options.extra.particles.toolti: Turns every particle off at once. The switches below turn off single kinds.
vulkanmod.options.extra.particleRenderDi: Particles that appear farther away than this are not created at all.
vulkanmod.options.extra.sky.tooltip: Sky gradient and sunrise / sunset colors.
vulkanmod.options.extra.weather.tooltip: Only the falling rain / snow is hidden. Weather sounds and splashes stay (splashes are the "Rain" particle).
vulkanmod.options.extra.fog.tooltip: Distance fog in the air. Fog under water, in lava and from blindness / darkness stays.
vulkanmod.options.extra.armorStands.tool: Visible armor stands. Invisible ones stay, because servers make holograms from them.
vulkanmod.options.extra.entityNameTags.t: Names of mobs and named entities. Server holograms are usually made of named armor stands and disappear too.
Blocks moved by a piston are hidden while they move.
vulkanmod.options.extra.coordsOverlay.to: Shown in the same corner as the FPS counter (top left when the counter is off).
